data.one_liner: Video player widget with Material/Cupertino controls
data.what_it_does: Chewie wraps the low‑level video_player plugin and provides a ready‑made UI with Material or Cupertino controls, subtitles, chapters, and casting support.
use_when: You need a quick, cross‑platform video player with a polished UI
You want built‑in subtitle support and option panels
You prefer to avoid writing your own controls from scratch
avoid_when: You need fine‑grained control over the video_player internals
You want to minimize dependencies or avoid an extra package
strengths: Easy to integrate with minimal code
Highly customizable options panel and UI
weaknesses: Relies on video_player, so any platform issues are inherited
Limited to the features exposed by video_player
data.setup_notes: Add chewie and video_player to pubspec.yaml and import both packages. No special permissions required.

alternatives.name: video_player
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides low‑level control without an extra UI layer

alternatives.name: media_kit_video
alternatives.why_pick_it: Full‑featured media player with advanced streaming support
